fusions.name: Cupping Glass
fusions.desc: Draws the poison out of the first enemy it meets, dealing 9 damage and healing you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Backwash
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage and leaving every enemy in it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Suckers on the Wound
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Bitterness Turned Tonic
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy wears off, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You carry 10% poison resistance.
